items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: And Mel said, and he has quoted this in his book also, that he said well why don’t you name him after the guy that drew him and call him Bugs, after Bugs Hardaway.

ctx.x: Do you have any memory of your father talking about this thing I’m working on at work and—

Well what happened was they had a cast of cartoon characters, one of them was a rabbit, I believe it was called Oswald. And it was a conventional rabbit. I mean its ears hung down and it went on all fours. And they wanted to update this character somehow, so the cartoonists all submitted their suggestions and ideas. And it turned out that my father’s was the one that was selected. And so Mel Blanc, the famous voice person, they were going to call it the Happy Rabbit originally. And Mel said, and he has quoted…
